ios.desc:
New Home Screen with your saved buses, directions, traffic cams & offline maps in one place — plus remove popup ads, Hi-Res 2026 maps & real-time bus timing

1. Exciting Features
- Redesigned Home Screen — search, and drag-to-reorder live cards for My Bus Timing, My Direction, Traffic Camera and Singapore Offline Maps, all on one screen
- Option to remove popup ads for quick access
- The most up-to-date Singapore maps with Hi-Res 2026 maps
- Comes with Free Offline Maps. Once you download the offline map, you can use the map without internet connection.
- Directions by Car, Taxi, Bus & MRT 
- Traffic, Bus timing & ERP pricing information
- Bus arrival time for all busses
- Set a bus arrival alert with a live Lock Screen countdown
- Tap on map for Building Directory and Bus Stop information
- Complete business directory listing of Singapore companies
- Shows up to 30 history searches

*Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

2. Please send us MORE feedback
- Feel free to send us more feedback on the apps, new feature(s) or any places or businesses that needs to be
added/updated. The Feedback page is available under Menu.

Streetdirectory.com
You will be lost without it
